newsitem.title: USA: Zamora Gold stock purchased by Vista Gold.
newsitem.headline: Zamora Gold stock purchased by Vista Gold.

text.p: Zamora Gold Corp said Friday it has completed the previously announced private placement of 3 million common shares to Vista Gold Corp at C$0.24 per share for proceeds of C$720,000.

The stock sale was approved by Zamora shareholders other than Vista Gold at the company's annual meeting on April 30. The proceeds will be used to fund exploration, operating expenses and land concession payments, Zamora said.
Vista Gold owns about 49 percent of Zamora's outstanding common after giving effect to the private placement.
The company describes itself as a Canadian mineral exploration company that controls the largest land position in the highly prospective Nambija gold belt in Ecuador.
